scripts.postinstall: sh -c 'set -e; TARGET_DIR="$PWD/node_modules/@naskot/node-hmac-auth"; if [ -f "$TARGET_DIR/dist/index.js" ]; then exit 0; fi; TMP_DIR="/tmp/node-hmac-auth-branch-$$"; rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; mkdir -p "$TMP_DIR"; cd "$TMP_DIR"; TARBALL=$(npm pack https://codeload.github.com/padcmoi/node-hmac-auth/tar.gz/refs/heads/feature/http-internal-key-propagation --silent); tar -xzf "$TARBALL"; cd node-hmac-auth-feature-http-internal-key-propagation; npm install >/dev/null; npm run build >/dev/null; rm -rf "$TARGET_DIR"; mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR"; cp package.json README.md LICENSE "$TARGET_DIR"/; cp -R dist "$TARGET_DIR"/'
